Population increased in Breckland

The estimated population of Breckland in 2024 was 146,620 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Breckland's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Breckland increased by 3.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Breckland was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Breckland

The average (median) age fell to 47.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Breckland has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Breckland is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Breckland's population of 146,620 usual residents was made up of:

  • 24,033 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.4%)
  • 85,054 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58%)
  • 37,533 people aged 65 years and over, (25.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Breckland has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Breckland, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Breckland
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Breckland, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 574 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 1,187 births and 1,761 deaths in Breckland.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,088 (1.4%). There were 8,215 people entering the area and 6,127 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Breckland's population of 122 (0.1%) as a result of 707 people entering the area and 585 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Breckland was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Breckland in mid-2023 is 144,934.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 237 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 384 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 147 people.
